summary: The reader assistant could not look at figures. The cause was neither the DeepSeek API nor the connection: the official vision guide says deepseek-flash accepts OpenAI-style image_url parts (base64 data URL) and the gateway sends exactly that, but the usage ledger shows paper_vision_qa was never called. The frontend attached a page image only when the question had Arabic digits (图2, Figure 2); the owner asked about 图二, so the question went out as text-only QA. A second, older bug: figure_page ignored the label kind, so Figure 2 resolved to the page with a Table 2 caption line, and a caption glued to the previous word (RobotwinFigure 2 Data construction) was not recognised. New app/static/figure-intent.js reads numbered references with Chinese numerals (图二, 第三张图, 表十二) and generic picture questions (这张图, 图中…, 上图, this figure) while topic words (图像生成, 图神经网络, image classification, 这表明) never attach a page; it also holds a kind-aware local fallback locator. app/service.py parses the same references, matches only the kind asked about with case-sensitive labels, recognises captions at a line start, before a colon, or before a capitalised caption sentence, and puts the caption page first in caption_passages. The composer gains a one-shot 附本页图 switch. qa() accepts an image only as a locally rendered base64 data URL (JPEG/PNG/WebP, at most 8 MiB of characters), never a link the provider would fetch, and appends a short vision instruction to the system prompt only when an image is attached.

budget_impact.rationale: No registry change. paper_vision_qa keeps its registered reference/cap (input 8000, output 1100 tokens), one page image per question, one attempt, no fallback, through the single gateway. The vision-only system note adds about 85 CJK characters (estimated 50-90 tokens, not measured), inside the registered 400-token instructions component. The official guide caps an image at 1024 tokens, below the 1500 registered for page_image_jpeg. Vision calls now actually happen when the owner asks about a figure; before the fix their real frequency was zero because of the bug, not by design.
budget_impact.before: paper_vision_qa registered with cap input 8000 / output 1100; real calls 0 (trigger bug).
budget_impact.after: Same registration and caps; triggered by numbered references incl. Chinese numerals, generic picture questions, or the explicit one-shot switch.
budget_impact.developer_usage: One paid paper_vision_qa call approved by the owner: input 3272, output 421 tokens, $0.0014868 reconciled, within the 8000/1100 cap ($0.00372 reserved). Other checks intercepted /api/qa in the page (fetch stub); figure-page and full-text endpoints are local and free.

quantified.period: one paper_vision_qa call at the registered cap, peak cache-miss price (8000 x $0.30/M + 1100 x $1.20/M); arithmetic from harness/budget.json, not a measurement

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; the evidence file also records the node tests.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; read the usage ledger and qa_history, fetched the official vision guide, confirmed the new Python tests fail on the old service.py, and in the browser preview checked with /api/qa intercepted that the owner's two questions attach page 4 (the real Figure 2), Table 2 attaches page 11, and a topic question attaches nothing.

Separate code-review subagent with no part in the implementation; read-only, no model calls. Round 1 FAIL: a blocking bug (ask() cleared the quoted page before reading it, so a quote's page was never sent), Python \b missing CJK-glued English labels (解释一下Figure 2), numbered and generic false positives (代表一个, 发表一篇, 试图一次, 第一个表示, 这个表示, 图神经网络, this graph neural network, 该图谱), the one-shot switch lost on failure, and an unmeasured token figure. All fixed with regression tests, or recorded as open risks (Figure S2 / Table IV, loose third caption tier). Round 2 PASS after running 46 inputs through both the JS and Python parsers; its three minor notes (tooltip token figure, 图模型, 上表/下表) were also fixed.

open_risks: One live image request was sent with the owner's approval (2026-10-01, I-JEPA, question 图二画的是什么？): the question auto-attached page 2, paper_vision_qa reconciled at input 3272 / output 421 tokens, $0.0014868 (usage ledger), and the answer described Figure 2's three architectures (joint-embedding, generative, joint-embedding predictive) with their encoders and predictor. One sample only: the PDF text layer also holds the figure labels and caption, so this does not prove the answer came from pixels alone, and reading quality on dense plots or other papers is unmeasured.
Picture-intent detection is a heuristic. A GNN paper's 图中的节点 still attaches the page (an estimated 1500 extra tokens, not measured); a question phrased without any picture word needs the 附本页图 switch.
Not recognised, so no page is attached automatically: supplementary and Roman-numeral labels (Figure S2, Table IV); the 附本页图 switch covers them.
The caption tier 'label + number + capitalised word' can pick a body sentence such as 'Figure 2 The' before the real caption; not seen in the owner's papers.
Pre-existing: with 更多上下文 the retrieved text can exceed the 4700-token retrieved_text component; the gateway reserves the cap, but actual input is not trimmed to it.
Verified in the Chromium preview; the .app WKWebView needs the owner's look.
